sources.cleanml_scope: ICDE 2021 BD: clean training data, evaluate on a fixed clean test. This caption experiment uses user-specified 10 (or 5) overlapping training-image subsets rather than the paper's original classification tasks and repetitions.
sources.prior_exposure: NOISY_POOL_RUN published graph/count/timing evidence and COVERAGE_EXPORT_RUN historical result snippets were read to check reuse. CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN test performance has not been read. COVERAGE_EXPORT_RUN historical metrics do not select any CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN parameter.

corpus.identity: Original NOISY_POOL_RUN Karpathy train/validation/test membership and leakage gates are immutable; no noise reconstruction or resampling.
corpus.provenance: original_image_id, is_copy, caption_source_image_id and caption_swapped are reporting/evaluation fields only. No cleaning method receives provenance. Validation truth is used only for the prescribed graph/t selection.
corpus.alignment: Feature arrays follow corpus row order; components follow record_id ascending. Align by record_id before joining.

methods.Keep-one: NOISY_POOL_RUN LR K=inf components; highest CLIPScore per component, tie smallest record_id.
methods.SemDeDup: GRAPH_SURFACES_RUN threshold-edge connected-components implementation on normalized cached ViT-L/14-336 features. Select k/epsilon on noisy validation graph exact F1; highest CLIPScore representative per train component, tie smallest record_id.
methods.CLIPScore filter: Remove the lowest CLIPScore records, tie record_id ascending; number removed equals b_cov deleted plus held/pending.
methods.Random: Random(20261104).sample from sorted record_id; remove the same number as b_cov deleted plus held/pending.
methods.VL-Dedup w/o check: COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN policy b, retained only; deleted and pending/held excluded.
methods.VL-Dedup: COVERAGE_EXPORT_RUN iterative b_cov export, retained only; deleted and pending/held excluded.
methods.Clean: Original 25009 clean captions, reference only, excluded from significance comparisons.

dedup.stage_a_d: Reuse NOISY_POOL_RUN B caches and frozen components, no rebuilding.
dedup.scorer: Frozen CLASSIFIER_RUN LR 11-feature adapter, calibrator and tau=2/3; K=inf from NOISY_POOL_RUN validation exact F1 27712/28103.
dedup.record_fusion: COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN: 0.5*midrank_percentile(CLIPScore)+0.5*midrank_percentile(Pyes), anchored to frozen original MISMATCH_SCORES_RUN validation references; invalid Pyes percentile=1.
dedup.t_selection: On 6852 noisy validation records only: maximize exact Fraction mismatch F1 using caption_swapped as truth, strict fused_score<t, choose first connected optimal threshold interval midpoint via run_action_checks.select_threshold (unbounded left uses upper). This adopts the paper MISMATCH_SCORES_RUN/COMBINED_ACTIONS_RUN selection rule requested by CAPTION_DOWNSTREAM_RUN, replacing the unused NOISY_POOL_RUN observed/nextafter smallest-t proposal. Freeze t before train export or test inference.
dedup.train_pairs: All unordered distinct pairs within frozen train K=inf components, canonical endpoints, lexicographic endpoint order; independently count before timing (published estimate 151983 is not an authority).
dedup.pair_prompt: STAGE_E_CLUSTERS_RUN pair_verdict_prompt, reviewer_veto, context none; parsed.decision via unchanged strict parser.
dedup.record_prompt:
Caption: {caption}
Does this caption correctly describe the image? Answer with yes or no.

sem_grid.kmeans: CPU spherical faiss, seed20261048, 50 iterations, nredo1, all records
sem_grid.edges: All unordered same-cell pairs with cosine>=1-epsilon, no kNN truncation; include isolates
sem_grid.selection: Validation exact component pairwise F1 on original-image groups, then fewer predicted-positive pairs, then listed grid order; train is reporting only.

dedup.coverage: Unchanged COVERAGE_EXPORT_RUN/COVERAGE_CHECK_RUN text-only prompt and strict JSON parser, Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Establish policy b, then b_cov_one_pass fixed-reference cache pass and iterative b_cov in COVERAGE_EXPORT_RUN order. Within each cluster deleted candidates: CLIPScore descending/ID ascending; retained references: ID ascending. Only valid covered=true permits deletion; false/null/invalid is rescued and added to future references. Record logical checks separately from newly inferred requests.

inference.engine: vLLM 0.11.0, float16, TP1, seed0, eager, chunked prefill
inference.invalid: Preserve raw terminal outputs; never retry token limits or fabricate labels.

timing_pilot.pair_sample: Random(20261104).sample(sorted canonical train pairs,1000), save sampled identities before model load.
timing_pilot.record_sample: Random(20261105).sample(sorted combined train/validation record IDs,256). Pair endpoints not in this sample provide context only, not extra scoring requests.
timing_pilot.measurement: Measure model load, record batches and 1000 pair batches separately. Batch wall includes prompt/image preparation, inference, parse and durable output. No early decision from fewer than 1000 pairs.
timing_pilot.projection: model_load_seconds + record_batch_seconds/256*42060 + pair_batch_seconds/1000*independently_counted_train_pairs; successful pilot terminal outputs reused in the full run.

subsets.sampling: Random(seed).sample(sorted original 5000 train image IDs,3500); restrict each globally frozen method's records by these original image IDs. Same image membership for Clean. No per-subset recleaning.

caption_model.initialization: GPT-2 small language pretraining only; no COCO caption checkpoint. Frozen OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 encoder; train GPT-2 plus mapping MLP512->3840->7680, tanh, prefix10.
caption_model.resource_note: NOISY_POOL_RUN model downloads are incomplete. Complete into this run's resources after Stage E gate passes; do not alter NOISY_POOL_RUN. Cached Stage A ViT-L/14 768-dimensional vectors cannot replace 512-dimensional ViT-B/32 prefixes.
caption_model.steps_per_subset: 10*floor(N_clean_records_in_subset/40); identical optimizer steps for all eight methods on this subset; cycle independently shuffled retained records as needed, drop last batch.
caption_model.schedule: Linear warmup min(5000,total_steps), then linear decay; inherited NOISY_POOL_RUN preset, no test-guided tuning.
caption_model.seed: Subset seed for identical initialization across methods; independent deterministic shuffled record stream per method using that seed.
caption_model.checkpoint: Final prescribed optimizer step only; no best-test checkpoint selection.
caption_model.decoding: Deterministic greedy, max40 tokens, stop EOS or first period; one caption per test image per trained model.
caption_model.timing: First train Clean subset1 to completion, evaluate its 5000-image test once. If its measured training time*80>30 GPU hours reduce subsets to first5; reuse this Clean model/evaluation. Project all training plus all evaluation, including prefix encoding and model loads; if >35 GPU hours after reduction stop. Record actual and projected separately.

evaluation.test: Fixed clean full Karpathy test, 5000 images, official references, no noise or cleaning.
evaluation.implementation: Official pycocoevalcap/PTBTokenizer; CIDEr raw scale, not x100. SPICE overall F1 plus macro mean of per-image All.r from official SPICE scorer. CHAIR original LisaAnne/Hallucination code with original COCO2014 captions/instances annotations.
evaluation.dependencies: New training/evaluation dependencies and OpenJDK in an independent conda environment under this run resource directory; do not modify vl-dedup or NOISY_POOL_RUN environments.
evaluation.usage: Test reporting only, except predeclared Clean CIDEr correctness gate; no parameter or method changes after reading test.

statistics.n: 10 paired subset metrics, or first5 after the training-time rule; Clean reference excluded.
statistics.contrasts: Each of six cleaning methods vs No dedup, and VL-Dedup vs each of six other non-Clean methods. The repeated VL-Dedup vs No dedup contrast is computed once: 11 distinct contrasts.
statistics.direction: Difference=first minus second for CIDEr/BLEU4/METEOR/SPICE/SPICE recall; difference=second minus first for CHAIR_i/CHAIR_s, so positive always means better.
statistics.tests: Paired t tests of mean oriented difference: two-sided, greater, less; alpha=.05; ddof1; identical zero differences have all p=1; nonzero constant differences have limiting p(two)=0 and directional p=0/1.
statistics.correction: One Benjamini-Yekutieli family contains all 11*7*3=231 raw p-values; no separate correction by metric, contrast or tail. Adjust p_(i) using min_{j>=i}(m*H_m*p_(j)/j), capped1.
statistics.flags: P if corrected two-sided<.05 and corrected greater<.05; N if corrected two-sided<.05 and corrected less<.05; otherwise S. No extra performance pass line.
statistics.tables: Mean +/- sample standard deviation, flags per contrast/metric, P/N/S counts. State subset overlap and paired experiment scope.

gates.1: Independent NOISY_POOL_RUN B counts equal corpus.expected; K=inf, validation exact F1=27712/28103, frozen leakage/graph gates pass. Mismatch stops.
gates.2: After protocol-only commit merge --no-ff 2d05166c; tests/test_coverage_export.py must all pass.
gates.3: Clean subset1 CIDEr>=.4. Below .4 stops without retuning.
gates.stop_policy: A failed correctness or time gate stops dependent work; preserve raw failures and partial outputs and report null with a reason for unexecuted metrics.

operations.gpu: Every GPU phase under flock; record nvidia-smi after acquiring lock and before model load. Background jobs durably update progress.json and append terminal records. Resume completed work, never silently rerun an unresolved admitted batch.
operations.master_snapshot: Opening full porcelain is 23 lines; save final full porcelain and compare bytes once at completion.
operations.hash_fields: N/A by explicit user prohibition; no new file hash manifests.

reporting.composition: Per method: records, distinct original images and distinct image assets, captions-per-original-image histogram including zero, retained copies/swaps, removed original non-copy/non-swapped captions.
reporting.upstream_downstream: Same table: retained swapped captions and removed original captions beside CHAIR and SPICE-recall P/N/S.
reporting.time: Actual Stage E, coverage, each training and evaluation; projections and lock waits separately. No execution claim from planned artifacts.
